evidence.notes: All three adopt the same catalog + connection-health IA, keep backend files and test selectors intact, remove the old one-click Remove and secret echo, and gate disconnect behind an impact dialog. No critical failures were found. X is the most balanced: it leaves the original test file untouched, shows remediation per row, and has a well-ordered detail page with solid focus management. Its only real weakness is fake zero counts during loading and error. Y has the richest state and governance handling: an ack checkbox, credential-deletion disclosure, redaction, no fake zeros, and row-level recommended actions. That is offset by visible polish defects (search icon overlap, misaligned headers) and a KPI-like status-tile row, and on mobile the detail actions are buried. Z is compact and calm and handles partial telemetry best at list level. It trails on state correctness (misleading empty catalog on error, Promise.all coupling), mobile labelling, dialog accessibility and disconnect gating.

scorer_rationale.task_hierarchy: The list is a clean health table with a 'Needs attention' filter. Rows have no action affordance, only a 'Reauthorize recommended' text hint and a name link. The detail page is well ordered: status panel with remediation, action bar with the recommended action primary, then overview and scopes.
scorer_rationale.domain_adaptation: Uses catalog + connection-health: a health table, a delayed-telemetry banner and a catalog with category counts next to the add form. There are no KPI or dashboard surfaces, and scopes/direction are expressed in domain terms.
scorer_rationale.contract_preservation: No api/mock changes and all selectors kept. Tests are appended to App.test.tsx, a README section is added, and a '*' catch-all route is added. Actions are filtered by allowedActions, and readOnly comes from the connections:manage permission.
scorer_rationale.interaction_state: Loading uses spinners, and the partial banner plus 'last known' badges are good. ConnectionsPage uses Promise.all, so one failure blanks everything. In the error scenario the catalog shows 'No connectors match “”' with zero category counts (primary-scenario-error.png). The disconnect confirm button is enabled before impact loads. STALE reload and receipts exist.
scorer_rationale.responsive: No overflow. Below 760px the table stacks into cards but the tds have no labels, so the mobile rows show bare '14 min ago' / '2 days ago' without saying which is sync and which is test (Z-p375). The detail page adapts fine.
scorer_rationale.accessibility: axe is clean and Tab stops are all focus-visible and named. However, the Dialog has no focus trap, Escape closes it even while disconnecting, and its useEffect depends on an inline onClose, so it re-runs every render and re-steals focus. Status shape icons are CSS-only. Smooth scrollIntoView ignores reduced-motion, and 🔒 emoji appear (aria-hidden).
scorer_rationale.visual_consistency: Compact, quiet and consistent. It includes a dark-mode palette and uses restrained badges with shape cues. Two-letter avatars on the catalog and detail header are mild decoration.
scorer_rationale.maintainability: Lean (2.7k LOC). CredentialInputs is shared between the add and rotate forms, and lib/connectors centralises labels and recommendations. The detail page is a single 660-line file.
scorer_rationale.ai_governance: The disconnect dialog shows sync jobs, scope ids, retention and workflows, and warns when unavailableSources exist. The Disconnect button is not gated on impact having loaded, and there is no acknowledgement step. Receipts come from the server result.

overfitting.dominant_ia: single health table with status/attention chips above a catalog grid + side add form; detail = status/remediation banner + action bar + overview/scopes + activity

strengths: Best list-level partial-telemetry banner plus 'last known'/'may be outdated' badges
Clear detail status panel with 'What to do'
Compact, calm visuals with dark mode
defects: No actions or remediation text in list rows
Error scenario shows misleading empty catalog 'No connectors match “”'
Unlabelled values in mobile row cards
Dialog lacks focus trap and re-focuses on every render
Disconnect can be confirmed before impact loads
